title: Alaabadayaashayda
empty: Wali ma jiraan alaabadayaal. Taabo + Kudar Alaabadaye si aad mid u bilowdo.
empty_hint: Kudar dadka ama dukaammada aad badeecada ka iibsato.
add_desc: Kudar qof aad badeecada ka iibsato. Magaca kaliya ayaa loo baahan yahay.
confirm_delete: Ma tirtirtaa {name}? Badeecadaha la xiriira alaabadayahaan waxay hayaan diiwaankooda.
error_generic: Wax qalad ah ayaa dhacay. Isku day mar kale.
settings_card_desc: Hayso diiwaan meesha aad badeecada ka iibsato. Kormeerayaasha ayaa weydiin kara halka badeecadahaadu ka yimaadaan.
assign_card_desc: Dooro alaabadaye oo ku xidh badeecado badan hal mar.
assign_hint: Calaamadi alaabta, dooro alaabadaye, ka dibna taabo Ku xidh.
assign_empty: Dhammaan alaabtu hore ayay u leeyihiin alaabadaye la xidhiidha.
assign_no_suppliers: Wali ma aadan kudarin alaabadaye. Mid ku dar marka hore, kadibna ku noqo si aad u xidho.
assign_error: Ma suurtagal ah in la xidho alaabadaye. Isku day mar kale.
